target.name: xx Packaging glass, green, at plant

strategy.label: template transfer from a BAFU unit process of the same product; main amounts calibrated within 0.5-2x
strategy.note: BAFU ships the Swiss green packaging glass as an aggregated xx dataset, but keeps the same product as a RER unit process (21 inputs). That structure is reused with the grid switched to CH (the datasets describe Vetropack's Swiss sites); ten amounts free within 0.5-2x.

evidence.source: bafu-2026: xx Packaging glass, green, at plant [RER] (unit process, 21 inputs)
evidence.note: Same product and reference unit; grid electricity switched to CH.

evidence.source: 2007 - LCI packagings and graphical papers - Hischier.pdf
evidence.note: The bundled report is a 17-page overview and prints no inventory table, so the sibling unit process is the only evidence.
